dedupe_keys.name: departement des alpes maritimes port and maritime datasets

description: Département des Alpes-Maritimes: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Alpes-Maritimes. Coverage: Département des Alpes-Maritimes. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aménagements cyclables du Département des Alpes-Maritimes; Sites inscrits au Plan Départemental des Espaces Sites et Itinéraires ; Limitations de vitesse hors agglomération dans les Alpes-Maritimes; Sites de covoiturage du Département des Alpes Maritimes. Formats seen: GPKG, OGC:WFS, CSV, PDF, XY. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
